capabilities: Crystallize notes, PDFs, audio, and images into structured memory files with source links
Chat with AI models using vault memory as context
Run inline AI actions on selected text or via Cmd+J
Generate dual-host podcast audio from notes
Generate presentations from notes with adjustable slide count
extras: Freemium: free 7-day trial, then paid plans from $39/mo up to a $999 lifetime tier. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires an internet connection for AI model access.
motivation: The author built it because existing AI tools forget the user between sessions; Monolithos instead crystallizes thinking into permanent, retrievable, source-linked memory.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistance, and generic AI assistants start each session from zero, with no persistent, traceable memory of the user's vault.

relations.evidence: backed by Claude Opus, Grok, and Gemini Pro

requires.name: iOS Shortcut for Black Hole capture

summary: AI companion plugin that crystallizes notes into retrievable structured memory, offers inline AI actions and chat, and turns notes into podcasts and presentations.
